findings.evidence: Every proof discharges the side condition with `F.timelike.ne'` only (lines 130, 139, 144, 174, 181); positivity itself (`F.timelike.le`) is used only where `Real.sqrt (g n n)` appears, i.e. in the energy lemmas (125, 182). Mathlib `Module.preReflection x f = y - (f y) • x` (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Reflection.lean:71) imposes nothing on `x`.
findings.fix: Define `Bilin.project (g : Bilin V) (u : V) : V →ₗ[ℝ] V := Module.preReflection u ((g u u)⁻¹ • g.flip u)` next to `Bilin.reflect` in `DIS/Tensors/Basic.lean`, state the eight lemmas there with hypothesis `g u u ≠ 0` (`project_apply`, `bilin_project_right`, `ker_project`, `range_project`, `bilin_project_project` with `g.IsSymm`), and set `Frame.spatial F := Bilin.project g F.n`, deriving the `Frame`-level forms from `F.timelike.ne'`.
findings.issue: `spatial` and its whole lemma suite (`spatial_apply` 119, `energy_div_smul_add_spatial` 123, `bilin_spatial_n` 129, `spatial_n` 138, `spatial_eq_self_iff` 141, `spatial_spatial` 148, `ker_spatial` 152, `range_spatial` 165, `bilin_spatial_spatial` 179) are bound to `F : Frame g`, i.e. to `0 < g F.n F.n`, but none of them uses positivity: each holds for any `u : V` with `g u u ≠ 0` (and `spatial_apply` with no hypothesis at all). This is the wrong level: the projection along a non-isotropic vector is a `Bilin` notion, not a frame notion, and the timelike bundling makes the API unusable for the spacelike axes §1.2/§1.3 need.

findings.evidence: `pTransverse g K = K.p - (g K.p K.q / g K.q K.q) • K.q` (DIS/Tensors/Basic.lean:292) is literally `spatial_apply`'s formula with `u = K.q`; `Bilin.apply_sub_smul_pair` (DIS/Tensors/Basic.lean:123) already states `g (x - a • u) (y - b • u) = g x y - b * g x u - a * g u y + a * b * g u u` for arbitrary `u`, and `q_sq_mul_pTransverse_self` (Longitudinal.lean:181) is the `a = b` case.
findings.fix: Prove the general `g (project g u a) (project g u b) = g a b - g a u * g b u / g u u` (from `Bilin.apply_sub_smul_pair`), then obtain both `Frame.bilin_spatial_spatial` and the DIS `q_sq_mul_pTransverse_self`/`transverseMetric_pTransverse_self` statements as instances.
findings.issue: `bilin_spatial_spatial` re-derives, by `field_simp; ring`, the shifted-pair expansion that already exists in general form in the repo, and its `a = b` case duplicates the existing `pTransverse` computation for a spacelike `u`. The general lemma is therefore proved twice, once per special vector.

summary: The projection half of the file is stated only for a timelike frame vector although every one of its lemmas needs just `g u u ≠ 0`, and the repo already carries the same construction for a spacelike `u` (`pTransverse`). The energy/norm/angle layer is at the right level.
